name: Incoming Gumdrop
summary: Incoming Gumdrop is a seasonal Hallow's End quest in Durotar where Kali Remik trades a sweet treat for a bit of playful humiliation. In order to obtain a Darkspear Gumdrop for an ailing orphan, adventurers must play along and mimic the sounds and motion of a steam train.

sections.title: A Troll's Price for Candy
sections.body: During the festive season of Hallow's End, heroes across Durotar collect traditional holiday sweets on behalf of a sick child in need of cheer. While Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village is happy to contribute a chewy Darkspear Gumdrop to the cause, she refuses to part with her confection without demanding the customary trick first.

sections.title: Playing the Fool
sections.body: Rather than demanding combat or dangerous trials, Kali asks visiting champions to drop their dignity and perform a train impression on command. Embracing the lighthearted revelry of Hallow's End, seasoned warriors and grim warlocks alike must make chugging engine noises and whistle blows to secure the sweet prize.

faq.answer: Kali Remik is a Darkspear troll resident located in Sen'jin Village along the southern coast of Durotar. During Hallow's End, she holds the Darkspear Gumdrops needed for the holiday festivities.

faq.q: Why do I need to make a train noise?
faq.answer: Hallow's End is built around tricks and treats. Even though the candy is collected for an ailing child, Kali insists on enjoying the holiday tradition by asking you to perform an absurd train impression before handing over the sweet.

faq.q: What is the Darkspear Gumdrop used for?
faq.answer: The Darkspear Gumdrop is one of several regional confections gathered across Horde lands to complete a festive assortment of treats intended to lift the spirits of a sick orphan.

faq.q: Where does this quest fit into the holiday?
faq.answer: This quest is only available during the annual Hallow's End celebration, serving as one of the regional errand quests that send Horde players visiting various settlements.

faq.q: Can Alliance players complete this quest?
faq.answer: No, this quest is exclusive to the Horde. Kali Remik is situated in the Darkspear settlement of Sen'jin Village in Durotar and will not offer treats to Alliance adventurers.
She can be found in Sen'jin Village, situated along the southern coast of Durotar, south of Razor Hill.

angles.text: Visiting Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village gives Darkspear trolls a chance to share holiday revelry on their home shores before heading out to other Horde settlements.
Gathering seasonal sweets across Durotar, Mulgore, and Tirisfal Glades brings together the disparate cultures of the Horde in a shared, lighthearted tradition.
